def.zh-tw: 把數排成橫列、直行的長方形陣列；有 $m$ 列 $n$ 行的叫做 $m\times n$ 矩陣，列數與行數相同的叫做方陣。
def.en: A rectangular array of numbers in rows and columns; one with $m$ rows and $n$ columns is an $m\times n$ matrix, and one with as many rows as columns is a square matrix.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：矩陣 matrix

def.zh-tw: 二元一次方程組 $ax+by=e$、$cx+dy=f$ 的係數行列式 $\Delta=ad-bc\ne0$ 時，恰有一組解 $x=\frac{\Delta_x}{\Delta}$、$y=\frac{\Delta_y}{\Delta}$，其中 $\Delta_x$、$\Delta_y$ 是把 $\Delta$ 的第一行、第二行換成常數 $e$、$f$ 所得的行列式。
def.en: When the coefficient determinant $\Delta=ad-bc$ of the system $ax+by=e$, $cx+dy=f$ is not $0$, the system has exactly one solution $x=\frac{\Delta_x}{\Delta}$, $y=\frac{\Delta_y}{\Delta}$, where $\Delta_x$ and $\Delta_y$ are the determinants obtained by replacing the first or second column of $\Delta$ with the constants $e$, $f$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：克拉瑪公式（克拉瑪法則） Cramer's formula (Cramer's rule)

def.zh-tw: 把一次方程組的係數矩陣右邊再加上一行常數項所成的矩陣，例如 $x+y=3$、$x-y=1$ 的增廣矩陣是 $\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1&1&3\\1&-1&1\end{array}\right]$。
def.en: The coefficient matrix of a linear system with one more column of constants added on the right; for example, the augmented matrix of $x+y=3$, $x-y=1$ is $\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1&1&3\\1&-1&1\end{array}\right]$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：增廣矩陣 augmented matrix

def.zh-tw: 對增廣矩陣反覆做列運算（兩列互換、某列乘以不為 $0$ 的數、某列的倍數加到另一列），把未知數一個一個消去，化成上三角的樣子後再由下往上代回求解。
def.en: Solving a linear system by repeated row operations on its augmented matrix (swap two rows, multiply a row by a non-zero number, add a multiple of one row to another), clearing the unknowns one at a time until the matrix is upper triangular, then substituting back from the bottom up.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：高斯消去法 Gaussian elimination

def.zh-tw: 對方陣 $A$，若有方陣 $B$ 使 $AB=BA=I$（單位方陣），$B$ 就是 $A$ 的反方陣，記作 $A^{-1}$。二階方陣 $\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix}$ 在 $ad-bc\ne0$ 時才有反方陣，為 $\frac{1}{ad-bc}\begin{bmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{bmatrix}$。
def.en: For a square matrix $A$, a square matrix $B$ with $AB=BA=I$ (the identity matrix) is the inverse of $A$, written $A^{-1}$. A 2×2 matrix $\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix}$ has an inverse only when $ad-bc\ne0$, and then it is $\frac{1}{ad-bc}\begin{bmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{bmatrix}$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：逆方陣／反矩陣 inverse matrix（課綱 A-11A-3 用「反方陣」）
